slides.headline: 11,372 Indian Villages Still Have No 4G, DoT Data Shows
slides.photo_credit: Photo: Rahulsince93 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0

bullets: Down about 75% in four years, DoT data shows
Mobile data is how most Indians get online
slides.credit_line: Source: DoT data obtained by The Hindu under RTI

slides.stat_label: Odisha Has the Most Villages Without 4G
bullets: Arunachal Pradesh is next, with 1,518 villages
Many listed villages there have few or no residents
slides.credit_line: Sources: The Hindu (RTI), Communications Today, The Pamphlet, Civilsdaily

slides.stat_label: People Estimated to Live in Villages Without 4G
bullets: About 46% of them in tribal-majority villages
26,000 more tower sites are already sanctioned
Telecom Minister Scindia's target: every village by June 2026
slides.credit_line: Sources: The Hindu (RTI), Communications Today, Civilsdaily, IANS
